description: Publish HTML/Markdown to Display, or work with Spaces files and folders. Use for publishing, sharing, browsing, sorting, search, bounded reads, exact edits, Word import, destination previews, document templates, uploads/downloads, history, Trash, access requests, Shared-Space management, key access, member deactivation, comments, watches, Inbox, notification preferences, Following, signup/claim, header visibility, or company domains. Triggers include "publish this", "share with the org", "find a file", "import Word", "create a folder", "edit this passage", "inspect file history", "save as template", "use this template", "set header visibility", "collapse the document header by default", or "respond to comments", "check my Inbox", "turn off update emails", or "unfollow this thread". Use for Display artifact URLs (*.dsp.so/*). Anonymous publishing returns a preview and browser claim URL.
